newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Victoria pegs gas prices to inflation.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Victoria pegs gas prices to inflation.

text.p: Gas price rises in the state of Victoria would be capped at the rate of inflation for 1997/98 (July/June), the state government said on Wednesday.
A 1.3 percent increase in gas tariffs from July 1 was in line with the consumer price index rate and would apply to both residential and commercial consumers, the government said.

"For the average household, the new tariff will mean only an extra 13 (Australian) cents a week and in real terms domestic gas prices have been reduced by four percent since 1993," the government said.
Gas prices in real terms for commercial customers were also falling, the government said.
The introduction of head-to-head competition through a dergulated market meant that consumers would pay the lowest possible tariffs, it said.
